notes.title: Important update
notes.content: We also want to inform you that you may experience problems with completing quests, this is due to a complete rework of the quest system. We are almost done developing quests and dialogues, which will allow us to add friendly NPCs.

notes.title: Settler's odyssey release day!
notes.content:
This is the very first presentation of the game to the public. Please, if you have the opportunity to report problems with the game, let us know: infomacrogames@gmail.com.
Thanks to everyone for supporting my project!
Have a good game!
